author: piratewithgun
body:
Dear Staff,

I am writing to appeal for my temp-ban for excessive infractions that I received earlier today.

For the staff members that did not see what happened I will give a short account of the events that took place in DTM02 at September 2, 2:21 PM. I was in Skype with marcwood501 who was defending the monument for the red team. I was on the blue team and when I got to the monument I blocked my sword to do a friendly sign to the four defenders, and as a result none of them hurt me. From then on I basically did nothing in the monument area and they made a cage for me out of iron bars with a sign that said: 'Our Hostage' which is where I stood. Shortly afterwards I was kicked for Team-Crossing by MOD Sessp (although none of the defenders that i was supposedly 'Team-Crossing' with received any punishment whatsoever).

In https://avicus.net/rules under Section B: Network Rules it states: "Do not cooperate with the enemy team in order to give your team an advantage." In all fairness I believe that I did not break this rule because neither team gained any competitive advantage. If I had broken their monument then I would have been breaking this rule, but we were just having a bit of a laugh. Therefore I think that the punishment was unfair for two reasons. Firstly the fact that I was not breaking any rules, and secondly because I was the only player to receive punishments for the ‘Cross-Teaming’.

As a result of this kick, I was subsequently temp-banned for excessive infractions. If Sessp's kick had not caused the month long ban that followed, I would not be appealing, but in the event, I hope that you will re-consider this infraction.

I also understand that if this gets appealed my next infraction will result in a temp ban.

I will respect your decision whatever that is, thank you.

Alex (4lextr)
